title: UnderstandingOutputSchema
description: JSON Schema for CivicFlow AI Understanding Agent structured output contract

normalized_text.description: Safely normalized text (lowercased, clean whitespace, preserved tokens)

signals.description: Extracted key semantic signals (e.g. material attributes, urgency markers, noise level)

entities.description: Extracted entities such as location markers, landmarks, ward numbers, time durations

safety_signals.description: Critical civic safety hazard indicators (e.g., live wire, open manhole, collapse risk)

missing_information.description: List of missing actionable information fields (e.g., location missing, vague description)

preprocessing_confidence.description: Overall text understanding & preprocessing confidence score
